translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Wod'eedda Uray Erettibeenna Wonjjalaa
«Hintte laattanaadan Med'inaa Goday hintte S'oossay hinttenttoo immiyaa gadiyaan, ooni wod'eeddentto erenna anhay kunddiide beettooppe,
hintte daannatuunne hintte c'imatuu biide, hewaa yuushshuwaan de'iyaa katamatuwaappenne he anhaappe gidduwaan de'iyaa haakotetsaa likkino.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, anhay kunddeeddasa matattiyaa katamaa c'imatuu, oosoo gakkabeenna, I morggiyaan k'ambbaray wod'd'ibeenna ussatto akkino.
Goggiyaa haatsay de'iyaa goshettibeenna sa'anne zerettibeenna zanggaaraa afiide, he ussatti morggiyaa mirk'k'iide mentsino.

Yaatooppe Leewiyaa naanay, k'eesatuu he sa'aa ittippe biino; ayaw gooppe, hawaa mala iita hayk'uwaanne mootuwaa shaakkiide pirddanaw, Med'inaa Goday hintte S'oossay bare sintsan ootsanaw, Med'inaa Godaa suntsankka anjjanaw unttuntta dooreedda.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, he anhay kunddeeddasa matattiyaa katamaa c'imatuu ubbay, zanggaaraan morggiyaa mirk'k'iide wod'eedda ussatti bolla barenttu kushiyaa meec'ettiide, hawaadan yaagino:
‹Nu kushii ha suutsaa gussibeenna; nu ayifiikka hawaa ootseeddawaa be'ibeenna.
Abeet Med'inaa Godaw, neeni wozeedda ne asaa, Israa'eeliyaa maara; ha geeshsha suutsaa ne asaa bolla naak'uwaa ootsaade paydoppa yaagino›. He suutsaa diraw, unttunttoo atto geetettana.
Hintte Med'inaa Godaa ayfiyaa sintsan hewaadan ootsiide, geeshsha suutsay gukkeedda nagaraa hintte giddoppe diggite.
Olan Omoodetteedda Mac'c'a asatuwaabaa
«Hintte morkkiyaanna hintte olettanaw kesina, Med'inaa Goday, hintte S'oossay, unttuntta hintte kushiyan aatsi immina, unttuntta omooddiyaa wode,
omoodetteedda asaa giddon itti malanchcha mishirato be'aade, izo amottaade, machche udanaw koyooppe,
ne golle ayaa; I huup'iyaa meedda; I s'uguntsaakka c'igga.
Omoodettiyaa wode de'iyaa mayuwaa k'aara diggaade, ne son uttaade, bare aawoonne bare daayiw itti aginaa kumentsaa kayyottu. Hewaappe guyyiyaan, izo akka.
Yaata simmina, izina de'iyaawe neena nashechchennan d'ayooppe, Aa bare koyyosaa baanaadan yedda agga. Neeni izo machche ootsaade ittippe ak'eeda diraw, izo shaluwaan zal"anaw woy kawushanaw bessena.
Bayira Na'ay Laattiyaa Maataa

«Itti asaw I dosiyaanne is's'iyaa laa"u mac'c'a asatuu de'ooppe, k'ay ha laa"atuukka aw attuma naanatuwaa yeleeddawantta gidishin, bayira yeletteeddawe ha is's'iyaa mac'c'a mishiratippe yeletteeddawaa gidooppe,
bare naanaw bare ak'uwaa I laatissiyaa wode, I is's'iyaanippe yeletteedda bayiray de'ishshin, I dosiyaanippe yeletteedda teefaa bayirayanaw bessena.

Hara naanaw immiyaawaappe laa"u kushiyaa aatsi immiyaawan ha is's'iyaani na'ay bayira gidiyaawaa erissanaw besse. Ayaw gooppe, he na'ay aw kushiyaa gediyaa p'alk'k'eedda bayira gidiyaa diraw, bayiratuwaa I akkanaw besse.
Aawoonne Aattiw azazetenaan is's'eedda Na'aa
«Aawoonne aatiw azazettenan is's'eedda, unttunttu seerinakka simmenna morggiyaa zoddaanne makkalanchcha gidiide simmenna na'i de'ooppe,
aawunne aata he katamaa penggiyaan de'iyaa c'imatuwaakko Aa oyk'k'i akki ahino.
C'imatoo hawaadan yaagino; ‹Hawe nu na'ay morggiyaa zoddaanne makkalanchcha; I nuw mulekka azazettena; miishshaa laali kaa'iyaawaanne ushshanchcha› yaagiide odino.

Hewaappe guyyiyaan, he kataman de'iyaa attuma Asay ubbay I hayk'k'ana gakkanaw, shuchchaan c'addiide Aa wod'ino. Hewaadan ootsiyaawaan hintte giddoppe iitaa d'ayissite. Yaatooppe Israa'eeliyaa ubbay hewaa sisiide yayana.
Dumma Dumma Higgetuwaa
«Itti Asay hayk'uwaa pirddissiyaa dabaa ootsina, hintte Aa mitsan kak'k'i wod'ooppe,

he kak'etteedda mitsan Aa anhay ak'oppo; Aa he gallassi moogite. Ayaw gooppe, mitsaa bollan kak'etti hayk'k'iyaa ooninne S'oossan shek'etteeddawaa. Med'inaa Goday hintte S'oossay hinttenttoo laata ootsiide immiyaa hintte biittaa hintte tunissoppite.
